source.base_materialization: The starting bundle sources were checked byte-for-byte against the GitHub tree of the base commit. The release commit is recorded in README_BUNDLE.md.

scope.primary_heart: Anticanonical heart qgr R_e; only AS heart is used as a comparison heart.
scope.first_forgetting: Set-theoretic choices above a fixed weak marking. The new finite bound and one-move reduction concern the specified AOU three-block line-object type, not all OU very strong helices.
scope.second_forgetting: Isomorphism classes of admissible line objects in the fixed anticanonical heart; existence, uniqueness and admissibility are distinguished from exact-autoequivalence orbits.
scope.groupoids_and_stacks: Deferred as a research priority until after set-theoretic classification; retained conditional formal comparisons are not a global stack theorem.
scope.line_reconstruction: Uses the known Artin-Zhang reconstruction theorem under its hypotheses, without asserting a new general reconstruction theorem.

mathematical_status.intrinsic_line_criterion: Retained proof: rank-one torsion-free objects have End=C and vanishing self Ext^2; exceptionality is equivalent to self Euler form 1. Rank-one torsion-free alone does not imply exceptionality.
mathematical_status.serre_positivity_rank: New deduction with proof and independent logical review: weak cubic axioms plus all-object cubic RR/H-action and r(O_0)=1 imply eventual higher Ext vanishing, the Hilbert polynomial, nonnegative rank, A_1={r=0}, r=1 for intrinsic rank-one torsion-free objects, and effective-degree positivity (EP). The converse A_0 implies d=0 is not proved.
mathematical_status.line_uniqueness: The numerical line uniqueness proof now uses (EP) and rank compatibility as consequences rather than extra assumptions. It gives an injective first Chern class map; general existence of every lattice class is not proved.
mathematical_status.weyl_frames: Actual AOU-type line markings inject into canonical lattice frames, so their number is at most 51840. If the remaining cross-block three-object reflection is realizable at every marking, the set is a W(E6)-torsor and Coxeter identities follow from uniqueness. Global categorical realization is not proved.
mathematical_status.formal_exhaustion: Conditional on the explicitly specified admissible relative heart, perfect base change and helix-lifting/generation hypotheses, all flat AOU-type line markings with rank-one torsion-free special fiber are the unique lifts of ordinary markings. This fixed-heart statement does not require Aut(X)=1.
mathematical_status.root_simple_obstruction: Conditional theorem with proof: existence of a degree-zero simple with nonzero c_1 gives an exceptional rank-one torsion-free evaluation kernel E with R_E isomorphic to R_O0 but non-ample (E,H). No such simple is constructed, and nonexistence under the full axioms is not proved.
mathematical_status.numerical_point_ext: Proved under the numerical hypotheses: for a simple with ch=(0,0,s), s>0, Ext^1 to and from any line object vanishes. This does not settle generation against positive-degree torsion.
mathematical_status.preserved_results: Existing commutative/formal comparisons, Picard obstruction and invariant proofs, universal relation algebra and numerical Serre/HH calculations are retained with their hypotheses.
mathematical_status.remaining_core: Realize the cross-block reflection; settle root-simple existence or exclusion and Line_adm=Line; determine the full set of realized line classes.

computations.verify_aou_relation_tangent.py: PASS: tangent and Smith ranks, universal 45-dimensional algebra, stated HH dimensions and numerical Serre Jordan type.
computations.verify_line_bundle_numerics.py: PASS: self Euler and defect, general-base Hilbert polynomial, Serre degree identities, parity and conditional root-evaluation defect.
computations.verify_weyl_frames.py: PASS: exhaustive 27 numerical (-1)-classes, 72 unordered sixes, 51840 ordered frames, E6 simple roots/Coxeter relations, AOU Euler matrix/frame recovery and candidate K0/Chern formulas.

checks.clean_rebuild_detail: All four computation scripts and the static checker were rerun from a new staging directory containing current source files only. latexmk -lualatex completed there with no copied build products, using the provisioned TeX runtime.
checks.lualatex: PASS: 33 pages; no overfull boxes, unresolved references/citations, missing glyphs or fatal errors. Nonfatal font-shape substitutions and mathematical-token bookmark warnings remain.
checks.visual: Inspected rendered pages 1, 3, 9-15, 17, 32 and 33, including the main new proofs, reflection formulas and bibliography; no clipping observed. A full page-by-page visual audit is not claimed.
checks.proof_audit: The new Serre/rank argument, root-simple obstruction, numerical-point lemma, frame reconstruction/reduction and formal exhaustion were independently reviewed by collaborating agents, and identified scope/dependency issues were corrected. This is not external refereeing or proof-assistant formalization; all retained older proofs were not re-refereed.
checks.primary_source_check: Checked Polishchuk Lemma 2.1(ii)/Theorem 2.4, AOU formulas (4.1)/(9.44), OU Definition 1.1(3), DGK Section 2.6, Hoffmann-Reede Lemma 3.9 and Seidel-Thomas Definitions 2.7/2.9 and Proposition 2.10 in primary sources. Karpov-Nogin Section 1.3 uniqueness statement was checked in primary-PDF search text, without a full fresh review of its proof.
